I will go to the cooperative and buy one bag of DAP for this plot, and I will split one bag of urea with my other plot because I do not have enough cash for more. I will also put two cartloads of cow manure on it since the land is mine and I want to keep it good. I will plant the seed I saved from last year, not the new packet from the shop, because I have not seen it grow with my own eyes and I cannot risk a bad harvest. My children and I will do most of the work, but I will pay three young men from the village to help for five days when the weeds are thick, because my back is getting old.
